issues.detail: The Greek 'θεοπνευστος' (theopneustos) means 'God-breathed' or 'inspired by God.' The Vietnamese 'soi dẫn' means 'guided' or 'led,' which is a different concept than the specific term for divine inspiration.
The Greek 'ελεγχον' (elenchon) refers to 'reproof' or 'exposition/conviction.' The Vietnamese 'bằng cớ' means 'evidence' or 'proof,' which changes the functional meaning of the text.
